validationLevels.name: Discovered
validationLevels.description: The project was located, but its source and runtime behavior have not been reviewed.

validationLevels.name: Source reviewed
validationLevels.description: Package metadata, composition files, lifecycle scripts, permissions, and obvious risks were reviewed.

validationLevels.name: Import compatible
validationLevels.description: Static dependency analysis and a real host-entry import probe passed in the named environment.

validationLevels.name: Composition mounted
validationLevels.description: An isolated DSH profile started with all expected Cordis rows active and tools registered.

validationLevels.name: Functional smoke
validationLevels.description: At least one representative end-to-end capability completed successfully in a controlled target.

validationLevels.name: Deployment validated
validationLevels.description: Exact source or artifact identity, acceptance checks, security notes, and rollback steps are recorded.

validationLevels.name: Locked baseline
validationLevels.description: The exact component is part of a maintained deployment lock and its complete acceptance contract.

evidence.description: Pinned artifact hash, source commit, build commands, and required capabilities are in the Windows Copilot deployment lock.
The maintained web and headless Profiles completed real host-entry import probes without fatal imports.
The validated Profiles loaded the expected plugin composition and registered the supported capabilities.

The rc.2 Desktop client ModuleLoader handoff, strict remote result codecs, strict JSON OAuth grant normalization, built-in pi-ai OAuth, authorization-service bootstrap, alpha.4 service reuse, account-available per-model API routing, direct Copilot hosted search, Desktop authorization UI, and fail-closed compatibility acceptance are documented.

notes: Model prompts, images, and hosted-search queries are sent directly to GitHub Copilot by DSH's built-in pi-ai adapter and this plugin.
The shared DSH credential record owns OAuth refresh; the plugin normalizes provider-owned grant fields to strict JSON, and deployment checks report only record metadata, never payload values.
Hosted search does not add a separate local approval prompt, gateway process, or ACP integration.

plugins.summary: The locked standalone DSH plugin with the rc.2 Desktop client ModuleLoader handoff, strict remote result codecs, strict JSON OAuth grant normalization, built-in pi-ai Copilot authorization, authorization-service bootstrap, per-model API routes, and direct provider-hosted search; no embedded gateway or ACP scope.
